name: Solar Scapes
old_description: Your solar system works every day to lower your energy costs, but even the best systems develop issues over time. Solar Shield removes the guesswork with scheduled maintenance, professional inspections, ongoing monitoring, and priority support from a local company that specializes in long-term solar care.
about:
Solar Scapes operates from Grain Valley, Missouri, serving the greater Kansas City metropolitan area. The company was founded on the principle that solar customers deserve ongoing support long after installation, a response to an industry where providers often disappear after the sale. Owner and field operator Cory B. leads a small team that includes field operations lead Grant H. and field technician Eric R.

The firm provides a full range of solar energy services: new system design and installation, troubleshooting and repair of existing arrays (including orphaned systems from defunct installers), annual maintenance through its Solar Shield membership program, animal-guard and skirting installation, solar removal and reinstallation for roof replacements, battery storage installation (certified for FranklinWH and Enphase), standby generator installation (certified Generac), and EV charger installation. The team of three performs electrical inspections, thermal imaging, drone-based aerial inspections, and active monitoring with production verification.

Solar Scapes serves residential and commercial customers across the Kansas City metro on both the Kansas and Missouri sides, including Overland Park, Olathe, Lenexa, Shawnee, Leawood, Lee’s Summit, Independence, Blue Springs, and Liberty. Its customer base includes homeowners with underperforming or damaged systems, businesses seeking backup power, and property owners needing roof-related solar removal and reinstallation.

The company differentiates itself by committing to long-term relationships rather than one-time sales, emphasizing honest diagnostics, repair-only-what’s-needed, and standing behind work for the life of the system. Its Solar Shield membership offers tiered preventative maintenance, priority scheduling, and discounts on repairs, aiming to catch issues early and maximize production over the system’s 25-year design life.
